reports.title: Primoris Services Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company is updating its estimates for the year ending December 31, 2026. Net income is expected to be between $65.2 million and $73.2 million, or $1.20 and $1.35 per diluted share. Adjusted EPS is estimated in the range of $2.10 to $2.25 per diluted share. Adjusted EBITDA for the full year 2026 is expected to range from $290.0 million to $310.0 million.
